landing.heroTitle: A professional profile and CV that carry your career forward.
landing.heroP1: Professional Profile is a quiet, private workspace where your professional profile and your CV live together, versioned and recoverable. You sign in, keep every field current, and grow your CV at your own pace — nothing leaves your account and nothing gets lost.
landing.heroP2: Every save quietly archives the previous version of your CV. When a change goes sideways, the version history hands the earlier text back in one step — the safety net that lets you write boldly.
landing.heroAlt: A focused team gathered around a table, reviewing documents together
landing.feature1Copy: Your profile fields, your CV and its version history share one private place — no exports, no copies, no scattered documents. Open the workspace and everything you have written is exactly where the account left it.
landing.feature2Copy: Sessions renew silently while you are active and stay bound to your device. Sign out whenever you want and the access ends everywhere the token did — your workspace waits, your data does not walk.
landing.feature3Copy: Every save, lock or limit answers in plain words — what happened, why it happened, and the exact next step, so no screen ever leaves you guessing.
landing.trust1Copy: Your workspace opens only for you; public routes stay public.
landing.trust2Copy: Every account is confirmed by email before it can sign in.
landing.trust3Copy: Clear guidance and patient feedback, without visual noise.
landing.growthAria: How the workspace grows with you
landing.growthTitle: Grown for the long career, not the first job.
landing.growthP1: A professional profile starts as one page and grows with you: the headline that opens doors, the bio that reads like you sound, and the CV that keeps its whole history. On a bad day you restore yesterday's text and keep writing today's — the account remembers, so you can focus on the career.
landing.growthP2: Until you decide a profile is ready to be seen, everything stays between you and your account. The workspace is private by construction: verified accounts, calm screens, and your professional story exactly as you left it.
landing.closingGuestCopy: Create an account in minutes and give your professional profile and CV the private, versioned workspace the career deserves.
landing.closingSignInCopy: Return to the app and continue where your work left off.
